ABOUT THE CATALOG

Sources & coverage

This is an incomplete research catalog, not an authenticated catalog raisonné. The total inventory of Kelly’s paintings is not established here. Records with missing details are preserved; works absent from the sources may still be missing entirely.

How to read the views

Dominant colors are calculated from the original SVG study: a chromatic family must occupy at least 40% of chromatic pixels and 10% of painted pixels. Neutral families must occupy at least 40% of painted pixels. These screen-area attributes do not measure the original paint. Rainbow, mixed and single-color filters describe the observed study palette; recoloring does not change classification. Arrange groups numeric attributes into labeled ranges and packs works inside evenly spaced category cells.

Research & rights ↗ · Suggest a correction ↗

“Earliest work per title” selects the earliest dated record in each recorded title group. Distinct works and later records remain available when this filter is off. A shared title does not establish that two records describe the same physical object.

Color and shape are discovery attributes. Check each record’s notes and source before treating them as authoritative. Recorded scale uses the recorded height and width, including multi-panel overall dimensions where supplied. In Gallery, choose Include estimated sizes or Estimated sizes only to include unresolved works using approximate dimensions. Estimates preserve the SVG proportions; open a work for its confidence, source anchors and comparable works. Catalog measurements remain unchanged. Estimation methods ↗ · Estimate data ↓.

Missing images have explicit placeholders. SVG studies are interpretive reconstructions; geometry and screen color approximate. Vivid preview adjusts their screen color and is not calibrated. Source photographs are not distributed in this project. Artwork representations and underlying artworks retain their respective rights.
